quality_checks.name: pitchcrew_startup_timing_bounds
quality_checks.query: SELECT event, count() AS invalid_observations FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND event = 'app_startup_finished' AND (properties.duration_ms IS NULL OR toFloat(properties.duration_ms) < 0 OR toFloat(properties.duration_ms) > 86400000 OR (properties.daemon_ready_ms IS NOT NULL AND (toFloat(properties.daemon_ready_ms) < 0 OR toFloat(properties.daemon_ready_ms) > toFloat(properties.duration_ms)))) GROUP BY event HAVING invalid_observations > 0

quality_checks.name: pitchcrew_request_metric_contract
quality_checks.query: SELECT event, count() AS invalid_observations FROM events WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND event = 'api_request_finished' AND (properties.result NOT IN ('success', 'http_error', 'network_error', 'invalid_response', 'aborted') OR properties.result IS NULL OR properties.duration_ms IS NULL OR toFloat(properties.duration_ms) < 0 OR toFloat(properties.duration_ms) > 86400000) GROUP BY event HAVING invalid_observations > 0

quality_checks.name: pitchcrew_engineering_import_freshness
quality_checks.query: SELECT 'engineering_ci_import' AS source, dateDiff('hour', max(timestamp), now()) AS age_hours FROM events WHERE event = 'pitchcrew_ci_run_completed' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY HAVING count() = 0 OR age_hours > 72
